{{Infobox auto}}

'''Grilled tomatoes''' are the simple preparation of [[tomatoes]]. They heal {{Value|Grilled Tomatoes|heals}} and grant {{EffectLink|Strength}} for {{Value|Grilled Tomatoes|duration|effect=Strength}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/grilled_tomatoes.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Tomatoes cook into grilled tomatoes in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Grilled Tomatoes|cook_time}}. Picking up tomatoes unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating grilled tomatoes takes {{Value|Grilled Tomatoes|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Grilled Tomatoes|heals}} and gives Strength {{Value|Grilled Tomatoes|level|effect=Strength}} for {{Value|Grilled Tomatoes|duration|effect=Strength|format=clock}}.

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
